definition.label: SR-57 Imperial Highway - screenshot left main carriageway
definition.notes: Count only the finite screenshot line across the left main carriageway, from its left road edge to the central divider. Exclude the right carriageway and the separate far-left ramp and triangular island before tracking. Increment only on a confirmed bottom-centre line crossing in capture UTC; a detection or ROI entry alone never counts. Published round definitions and all capture-clock, coverage, framing and tracking checks remain intact.
